02 / HOW TO SURVIVE✦
  1. Watch the gems.Each column belongs to a bandmate. Hits damage the enemy.
  2. Meet the beat.A / S / D / F go left to right. You can switch to arrows or D/F/J/K above the lanes. Tap the keycaps on mobile.
  3. Keep it going.Only notes that pass the line cost health. Early or wrong taps give advice, without extra damage. Beginner starts with slow, spaced notes.
